questions.question:
In a series RLC circuit at resonance, the magnitude of the voltage developed
across the capacitor
options: can never be greater than the input voltage

can be greater than the input voltage, however, it is \(90^{\circ}\) out of phase with
the input voltage

questions.explanation:
In a series RLC circuit, at resonance
\(V_L=jQV_{source}\) and \(V_c=-jQV_{source}\)
also for \(Q \gt 1, |V_c| \gt |V_{source}|\)
Hence, option (C) is correct.

questions.subject: control-systems
questions.question:
Given the homogeneous state-space equaion
\[\dot{x}=\begin{bmatrix} -3 &1 \\ 0&-2 \end{bmatrix}x\]
the steady state value \(x_{ss}=\lim_{t\rightarrow \infty }x(t)\), given the initial state value of \(x\left ( t \right )=\left [ 10-10 \right ]^{T}\), is
questions.explanation:
\[[sI-A]^{-1}=\begin{bmatrix} s+3 &-1 \\ 0 & s+2 \end{bmatrix}^{-1} =\begin{bmatrix} \frac{1}{s+3} &\frac{1}{(s+2)(s+3)} \\ 0& \frac{1}{s+2} \end{bmatrix}\]
\[e^{At}=L^{-1}[sI-A]^{-1}=\begin{bmatrix} e^{-3t} & e^{-2t}-e^{-3t}\\ 0 & e^{-2t} \end{bmatrix}\]
\[x(t)=e^{At}X(0) =\begin{bmatrix} e^{-3t} & e^{-2t}-e^{-3t}\\ 0 & e^{-2t} \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 10\\ -10 \end{bmatrix}\]
\[\therefore \;\; x(t)=\begin{bmatrix} 20e^{-3t}-10e^{-2t}\\ -10e^{-2t} \end{bmatrix}\]
\[\therefore \;\; X_{ss}=\lim_{t \rightarrow \infty }\begin{bmatrix} 0\\ 0 \end{bmatrix}\]

questions.subject: electrical-machines
questions.question: A star-connected 440 V, 50 Hz alternators has per phase synchronous reactance of 10\(\Omega\). It supplies a balanced capacitive load current of 20 A, as shown in the per phase equivalent circuit of figure. It is desirable to have zero voltage regulation. The load power factor should be
questions.explanation:
\[\begin{aligned} E_f\angle \delta &= V\angle 0+I_a\angle \phi \cdot Z_s\angle \theta \\ &= V\angle 0+I_aZ_s\angle \phi + \theta\;\;...(i) \end{aligned}\]
Squaring both side, we get,
\(|E_f|=|V|^2+|I_a|^2|Z_s|^2+2 |V||I_a||Z_s| \cos (\theta +\phi )\)
For zero regulation, \(|E_f|=|V|\)
\[\begin{aligned} \Rightarrow \; \cos (\theta +\phi ) &= -\frac{|I_a||Z_s|}{2|V|}\\ &= -\frac{20 \times 10}{2 \times \frac{440}{\sqrt{3}}}\\ &= -0.3936\\ \theta +\phi &= 113.178^{\circ}\\ \phi &= 113.178^{\circ}-90^{\circ} \\ &= 23.178^{\circ}\\ \cos \phi &= 0.9192 \end{aligned}\]

questions.question: An n-channel JFET, having a pinch-off voltage (\(V_{p}\)) of -5 V, shows a transconductance (\(g_{m}\)) of 1 mA/V when the applied gate-to-source voltage (\(V_{GS}\)) is -3V. Its maximum transconductance (in mA/V) is

questions.subject: power-electronics
questions.question: A half-wave thyristor converter supplies a purely inductive load, as shown in figure. If the triggering angle of the thyristor is \(120^{\circ}\), the extinction angle will be
questions.explanation: \[\begin{aligned} V_m \sin \omega t&=L\frac{di}{dt}\\ \frac{di}{dt}&=\frac{V_m}{L} \sin \omega t\\ \int_{0}^{i}di&=\frac{V_m}{L} \int_{\alpha }^{t}\sin \omega t\; dt\\ i&=\frac{V_m}{\omega L} \cos \omega t|_t^\alpha \\ i&=\frac{V_m}{\omega L} (\cos \alpha -\cos \omega t)\;\;...(i)\\ \text{For extinction angle, at }&\omega t=\beta ,i=0\\ \Rightarrow \;0&=\frac{V_m}{\omega L} (\cos \alpha -\cos \beta )\\ \text{Which gives, }& \cos \alpha = \cos \beta \\ \beta &=2 n \pi \pm \alpha \\ \text{For, } n&=1\\ \beta &=240^{\circ},480^{\circ} \end{aligned}\]
